assets.name: courtyard
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean environmental background layer for the playable Fortress AI menu.
Input image is the exact visual/composition reference. Recreate its sunny illustrated medieval courtyard as closely as possible, but REMOVE ALL interface elements and foreground characters.
Keep the same wide landscape camera, beautiful blue sky and soft clouds, mountains and green alpine valley on the left, grand pale-stone red-roofed castle and aqueduct bridge on the right, foreground stone parapets/towers and stone arch sides framing the two edges, sunlit grass, little stream and cobbled courtyard floor. Same premium polished colorful 3D-painted cartoon game art, crisp stone and gold highlights, warm daylight.
Remove completely: central parchment/stone menu board, central logo/crown/ribbons, every input/button/UI rectangle, all words/numbers/icons, header badge and soundbutton, BOTH kings, BOTH cannons and cannonballs. Replace those areas naturally with the continuous courtyard/valley scenery. Keep crates/barrels tucked only at the extreme bottom corners if useful, not in center.
Also remove the TWO LARGE red hanging crown banners in the top corners; leave the stone supports clear because separate animated banners will be added in code. Distant little castle flags can remain.
The center must be an unobstructed natural view where a separate menu panel can be placed, not a blank solid-color cutout. Foreground grass/stone floor spans the bottom 20% and provides a clear flat standing baseline for independent character sprites.
Landscape 16:10 composition matching input. This is ONLY an opaque background environment, no text, no UI, no characters, no cannons. Do not redesign into a different scene.

assets.name: panel
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE isolated blank central menu board, transparent background, for real HTML controls to be overlaid.
Extract/recreate ONLY the central stone-and-parchment board from the supplied Fortress AI reference, matching its material, lighting, proportions and finish as closely as possible.
A broad nearly-square rectangular warm ivory parchment interior, surrounded by thick hand-hewn pale sandstone columns and base, subtle gold metal edging and capped top corners. On both upper side columns hang the same narrow royal BLUE cloth banners with gold borders and a simple gold crown emblem. Keep the small gold diamond ornament at the bottom center. The parchment is pleasantly textured but CLEAN and evenly lit, readable under text.
COMPLETELY REMOVE the large FORTRESS AI logo/crown/ribbons above the board (it will be a separate layer). Remove every input field, button, label, text, icon, playername, roomcode and How to Play element, leaving one uninterrupted blank parchment interior.
Keep stone torch mounting blocks on the side columns but remove the flame and bowl, because those are separate animated layers. No kings, cannons, castle, sky, ground or background scenery.
Exact one board, frontal orthographic view, no perspective tilt. Broad 1.08:1 width:height shape matching the reference central board. Generous transparent margin all around, no clipped banners or columns. Actual alpha transparency. No words, letters or labels anywhere. Premium polished cartoon game illustration with warm top-left daylight.
